note: Evil Mode slice 10, the base. Design /mnt/project-files/plans/evil-mode/16_THE_BASE.md (sites, rooms, sizes, staffing, adjacency, build orders, Night actions), 17_THE_REVERSE_DUNGEON_AND_THE_RAID.md (pieces, the fairness check, Walk it, the warning, the Raid on the Siege Map, after), 05_THE_NUMBERS.md (building costs). Numbers are the design's starting values; none are playtested. Text is the design's own. `on: false` is the slice's undo: the base is one room (the Common Room) and nothing is built, defended or raided.

fixed.door: One square, on an edge. Where everyone comes in: applicants, the detective, the Hero.
fixed.common: Free. Every base has one from the first evening. A kettle. A noticeboard. Pegs. It does nothing to any number. It's the room the game's set in.
fixed.office: The Boss's. The furthest square from the front door, always: the game places it. The last room.

sites.name: A cellar under a shop
sites.and: A Front upstairs comes free (the shop itself, back room shut). One way in, through the shop.
sites.local: The shopkeeper. They know. Their mood's the base's weather.
sites.evening: Tobi finds the light switch. It doesn't work. Lux finds the fuse box. Faye's already sweeping. Otis stands in the middle, turns round once, and says: "It's got a door. That's a start."

sites.name: A warehouse
sites.and: Room for a Garage from the start: it's free and built. Easy to find: Heat reads one higher for the purpose of the Raid.
sites.local: A night watchman, sixty, who'd like to keep his job and his chair by the door.
sites.evening: The watchman's chair is by the door. Nobody moves it. Somebody finds the light board, and the whole roof comes on at once, row by row, like a held breath let go.

effects.text: Heat reads one higher for the Raid

sites.name: A cave
sites.and: Heat finds it two points late (the Raid comes two Evenings later). Damp: a Workshop costs half again.
sites.local: A hermit, or a colony of Zubat. Either way they were here first.
sites.evening: Something flutters, high up, and settles. Water drips somewhere it always has. Hortense puts the kettle on a flat rock and says it'll do.

effects.text: The Raid comes two Evenings late
The Machines Doctrine's kits lose a level here
effects.waits: Kit levels by site come with a later slice.

sites.name: A ship
sites.and: Rooms are in a row, so adjacency's only ever two neighbours. The harbour master's owed mooring fees: ₽200 a district.
sites.local: A harbour master, who's owed mooring fees: ₽200 a district, or a favour.
sites.evening: The deck moves. Tobi is sick over the side and says he's fine. The harbour master watches from the quay with a notebook open at a fresh page.

effects.text: It moves, once a district, to any coast holding
effects.waits: Moving the base comes with the Crossing (slice 16).

sites.name: A big house
sites.and: Applicants think it's respectable. So does the detective, for a while.
sites.local: The family that used to own it, in the gatehouse. One of them's old and remembers the ballroom.
sites.evening: There's a ballroom. Nobody says anything for a moment. Then somebody walks to the middle of it and their footsteps go all the way up.

sites.name: A place nobody wanted
sites.and: Free: no purchase, no rent. Regard +1 with the people who were already living there, and they stay.
sites.local: Four or five people with nowhere else. They're not on the Roster. They eat in the Mess if there's one.
sites.evening: There are people here already. An old man with a kettle. Nobody says anything. Hortense says: "Is that tea?" It is.

effects.waits: A drawn grid comes with a later slice; the ruin's shape is fixed for now.

sites.name: The old Safari warden's lodge
sites.and: The fence. Wild Pokémon wander the yard. Koga's district's on the doorstep and Janine's noticed.
sites.local: The old warden, who lost his teeth in the Safari Zone and still goes looking.
sites.evening: Something wanders across the yard in the dusk and doesn't hurry. Somebody says it's a Rhyhorn. Somebody says it isn't. The fence holds either way.

effects.waits: Kit recovery comes with a later slice.

sites.name: Under the Burned Tower
sites.and: A Dig's Site comes with the house.

sites.name: A secret base
sites.and: Heat for having a base is nil; children have them.
sites.local: The Hero's got one too, two routes over.

sites.name: The Underground
sites.local: The Underground Man visits and offers decorating advice.

sites.name: A château's servants' wing
sites.and: Respectable, doubled; a yard with good soil.
sites.local: The château's owner hasn't been home in six years.

sites.name: The abandoned megamart
sites.and: It's haunted. Properly: a Mimikyu, and it's lonely.

sites.name: A narrowboat on the canal
sites.and: A ship's rules, at walking pace.

sites.name: A lighthouse keeper's cottage
sites.and: The lamp room's a free Large Office.
sites.local: The Hero lives down the hill.

rooms.name: Barracks

sizes.does: Roster cap +4 (to 12)
sizes.looks: Bunks. A stove. Somebody's sock
Lockers. A table for cards

sizes.does: +4 (to 20). And bunks have names on
sizes.looks: Curtains. Photographs from home. A shelf of borrowed books

rooms.hand: It runs on whoever's in it.

first.line: More of us. Right. Who's training them?

rooms.says: The beds have names on. I read them all.

rooms.name: The Mess

sizes.does: Loyalty +1 a district, everyone
sizes.looks: A long table. A hatch. Stew

sizes.does: And applicants +1 a day
sizes.looks: Two tables. A rota on the wall

sizes.does: And the Hero may eat here, if they're let
sizes.looks: The door to the yard's propped open. There's always one more chair than people
sizes.waits: The Hero at the base comes with the fires and the last room (slice 12).

rooms.hand: "A kitchen. Of my own. With a door that shuts." They open every cupboard. "No. With a door that doesn't shut. That's the point of a kitchen. Who's peeling?"

first.line: Good. I'd have thought less of you.

rooms.says: They've a kitchen. Somebody offered me soup. I didn't take it. I wish I had.

rooms.name: The Garage

sizes.does: Reach +2
sizes.looks: A van. A pit. A radio playing something nobody chose

sizes.does: A fourth squad
sizes.looks: Two vans. A board with keys on hooks, and a rule about the hooks

sizes.does: A getaway that can't fail: once a district, a failed job's "caught" becomes "got away"
sizes.looks: A third vehicle under a tarpaulin
sizes.waits: A job that can be caught comes with the Heists (slice 14).

rooms.hand: "I'll want the manuals. All of them. And nobody touches the seat position. I mean nobody." They mean the Boss.

first.line: Somewhere to be that isn't here. Sensible.

rooms.says: Two vans and a pit. They can be anywhere by morning.

rooms.name: The Counting Room

sizes.does: Funds here are safe in a Raid (a tenth lost, not half)
sizes.looks: A table. A lamp. A cash box with a combination everyone knows

sizes.does: Rackets +25%
sizes.looks: A safe. Ledgers in a row, spines out, dated

sizes.does: The Ledger shows a day ahead
sizes.looks: A second desk. The assistant's got a plant
sizes.waits: The forecast comes with the economy (slice 11).

rooms.hand: "Double entry. From today. I'll need every receipt since the Founding." Tobi's kept his in a shoe. "...In a shoe."

first.line: Before a kitchen. I see. No: I approve. I just see.

rooms.says: Two books. One's what they took. One's what they gave. Somebody's kept both up to date.

rooms.name: The Infirmary

sizes.does: Fainted Pokémon back next day
sizes.looks: Two beds. A cabinet. A Chansey asleep on the spare one
sizes.waits: Kit injuries come with a later slice; the Boss's own party is healed after every battle already.

sizes.does: And people: a flaw doesn't fire while they're resting
sizes.looks: Four beds. Screens. A kettle of its own
sizes.waits: Resting comes with the Night's knocks (slice 7).

sizes.does: Free to anyone. Including whoever just raided you. Regard +1 a district
sizes.looks: A door onto the street. A lamp over it. A sign: "Anyone. No questions."

rooms.hand: "I'll treat who comes. I won't ask what they did. If that's a problem, say so now and give the room to someone else."

first.line: You're expecting us to get hurt, or you're expecting to hurt someone. Which?

rooms.says: They patched up my Pokémon. I was there to arrest them.

rooms.name: The Listening Post

sizes.does: The Hero's next step on the road
sizes.looks: A radio. Headphones. A map with one pin

sizes.does: The Hero's next two. The district's holdings scouted to depth 1, free
sizes.looks: Three radios. Tape. A wall of string that's somebody's system

sizes.does: The detective's next move
sizes.looks: A switchboard. A cot

rooms.hand: "Good. I'll need it quiet. I'll tell you what I hear and I'll tell you when I'm guessing, and you'll know which is which because I'll say."

first.line: You want to know what's coming more than you want anything else. Me too. It's not a nice way to be.

rooms.says: There's a map with my road on it. Every stop. They've known where I was the whole time and they never once—

rooms.name: The Workshop

sizes.does: One gadget a district
sizes.looks: A bench. A vice. A glider with one wing
sizes.waits: The gadgets come with the Scheme (slice 14).

sizes.does: Two. Puzzle floors cost nothing
sizes.looks: Two benches. A lathe. A sign: TOBI: NO

sizes.does: A Key can be made, clean
sizes.looks: A third bench, under a sheet
sizes.waits: The Key comes with the Scheme (slice 14).

rooms.hand: "I'd rather make a thing than take it. You know that. You knew it when you hired me." They run a hand along the bench. "This'll do."

first.line: Can I have a go on the lathe?

rooms.says: Somebody builds things here. There's a note on the lathe that says TOBI: NO.

rooms.name: The Vault

sizes.does: Holds two relics
sizes.looks: An iron door. A shelf

sizes.does: Four. A Sign's kept as it should be
sizes.looks: Racks. Labels. A book that says where each thing came from

sizes.does: The Scheme's parts can't be lost
sizes.looks: A second door inside the first

rooms.hand: "So I stand here." "You stand here." "And if it's you says open it, at three in the morning, and you don't look right?" A pause. "Then you don't open it." "Right. Good. Wanted to hear you say it."

first.line: What've you got to put in it? ...No. Yet. I heard the 'yet.'

rooms.says: A man at the door. He let me look. He said, 'Look. Don't touch. Half of it's going back.'

rooms.name: The Holding Pen

sizes.does: Holds four Pokémon taken from someone
sizes.looks: Four stalls. Straw. A water trough
sizes.waits: No job takes a Pokémon yet: the Pen stands empty, with its latch.

sizes.does: Eight
sizes.looks: Eight. A drain. Somebody's put a blanket in one
sizes.waits: No job takes a Pokémon yet.

sizes.does: Twelve
sizes.looks: Twelve. The blankets are in all of them now. Nobody's said who
sizes.waits: No job takes a Pokémon yet.

rooms.hand: They take the key. They don't say anything.

first.line: (Nobody says anything. They ask to be on days.)

rooms.says: I looked for the cages. There were cards on every door.

rooms.name: The Shadow Lab

sizes.does: One Pokémon a district: its heart's shut. Kit +2 levels, Shadow moves, never refuses. Corruption +1 when built, and it only rises
sizes.looks: A steel door. No window. A hum

sizes.does: Two a district. Corruption +1
sizes.looks: The hum's lower. The corridor outside's colder than the rest of the base

sizes.does: Four a district. Corruption +1
sizes.looks: The next room's Specialist has asked to be moved. They've been moved. The room after that's asked

rooms.says: I'm not writing down what was in that room.

rooms.name: The Office

sizes.does: A desk. The Board's on the wall behind it. Night knocks happen here
sizes.looks: A desk. A chair. A second chair, for whoever knocks

sizes.does: A wall: what's on it's the player's
sizes.looks: The Wall
sizes.waits: The Wall's pin-board comes with the voice (slice 18).

sizes.does: A window. Stand at it at Night; in a Raid, go out of it
sizes.looks: The Long Window. The whole of the district, and at night, lights

rooms.says: You can see the whole town from their window.

rooms.name: The Creed's room

sizes.does: Where the Finale happens. Built in the last region
sizes.looks: By the Creed
sizes.waits: Built in the last region: Kanto is the first of three.

rooms.says: Anybody can see what they're for.

creedRooms.name: The Ledger Hall
creedRooms.has: Every coin the team's taken, on shelves, in order, and under each a brass plate with whose it was

creedRooms.name: The Hall
creedRooms.has: A stage. Chairs. The sentence on the back wall, in letters a foot high

creedRooms.name: The Engine
creedRooms.has: The Means. It hums. Then it doesn't

creedRooms.name: The Common Room, with the door off
creedRooms.has: The kettle. The wall of names

adjacency.does: Loyalty +1 a district. They can smell breakfast
The flaw Drinks stops firing. There's always someone up
adjacency.waits: Flaws firing at Night come with slice 7.

adjacency.does: Loyalty −1 a district. They can hear it
Somebody starts treating what's in the Pen. "Since then" gets kinder
adjacency.waits: No job takes a Pokémon yet.

adjacency.does: Scraps go through the hatch. Nobody's allowed to. Everyone does
That room's Specialist asks to be moved
Gadgets for vehicles: a getaway's odds +10%
A relic can be copied. The copy fools a buyer, not a scholar
The Boss hears the Post's report the same Night, not at Morning
Nobody sleeps well. Once a district the Post tells the Boss one thing
Funds in a Raid: nothing lost
The books eat at the desk. The kitchen takes it personally. A tie forms, of the bickering kind
adjacency.waits: Ties come with the long cast (slice 17).

adjacency.does: Squads leave a step faster. And the detective's seen the vans
It's on the street. "Anyone" find it. Regard +1 a district more
The Raid's first room's got everyone in it
Not allowed: the game places the Office furthest
Anybody can see what the team's for. Heat +1. Regard or Dread +1

pieces.name: Warp pads
pieces.is: A puzzle of rooms: step on one, arrive on another
pieces.rule: Every pad's reachable; the exit's reachable from the entrance.
pieces.writes: Pads. I kept arriving where I'd started.

pieces.name: A switch door
pieces.rule: The switch is on the intruder's side of the door, somewhere.
pieces.writes: A door with no handle. The switch was two rooms back.

pieces.name: A dark floor
pieces.rule: A light's findable before it: a lamp, a Grunt's Pokémon, a window.
pieces.writes: Dark. Somebody's Pokémon lit it for me.

pieces.name: A conveyor
pieces.is: Belts that carry. Step on wrong and it's back to the door
pieces.rule: One sequence of belts reaches the far side.
pieces.writes: Belts. Back to the door, twice.

pieces.name: Ice
pieces.rule: A solution of twelve slides or fewer.

pieces.name: Bins
pieces.is: Two switches, hidden in a room of bins
pieces.writes: Bins. The second switch moved. The Roster thinks it's hilarious.

pieces.name: A locked door, and a key
pieces.is: A key held by a Grunt, or lying in a room
pieces.rule: The key's somewhere the intruder can get before the door.
pieces.writes: A locked door. The key was in a room I'd already walked through.

pieces.name: A quiz door
pieces.rule: The answers have to be things a person could know: findable inside the base before the door.
pieces.writes: A quiz. They asked me {ask} I had to go back and look.

pieces.name: A weighing plate
pieces.is: Something heavy has to be left on it
pieces.rule: The heavy thing's in an earlier room.
pieces.writes: A plate in the floor. I carried a chair from the room before.

pieces.name: A long corridor
pieces.rule: It costs the intruder nothing but time. A day of the Hero's, if there are three.
pieces.writes: A long corridor. It was just long.

pieces.name: A decoy office
pieces.is: A room that looks like the last one: a desk, a chair, a wall
pieces.rule: The Hero's delayed a day. They're cross about it for the rest of the run.

pieces.name: A back way
pieces.is: A door out, for the team
pieces.writes: A door to the outside, from the inside. For them.

pieces.name: A viewing slot
pieces.is: A hatch in a door, from the team's side
pieces.rule: The Boss sees the next room's log a room early when watching.
pieces.writes: A hatch in the door. Somebody was watching.

quiz.subject: The team
quiz.ask: How many are in the Pen?

fair.path: There's no way from the door to your Office. {room} is walled in.
fair.key: The key to door {n} is behind door {n}.
fair.switch: The switch for door {n} is on the wrong side of it.
fair.puzzle: {piece} in {room} can't be crossed. There's nothing to stop on.
fair.light: It's dark in {room} and there's no lamp before it.
fair.heavy: There's nothing heavy to put on the plate in {room}.
fair.quiz: Nobody could know that. Put it on a wall somewhere, or ask something else.
fair.backway: The back way goes to a cupboard.
fair.dead: Nobody can get into {room}. That includes you.
fair.ok: A route exists. Every key's before its lock.

bands.says: You'll have to go through me again.
Fair enough. Third door's a floor puzzle. I'm not telling you how.
Is it true there's dental? ...No, on your side. Is there.
Third door. He's not what you think. He might be. I don't know any more.
(Nothing. They're outside, having shown the way in.)

flaws.proud: They fight a level up and can't be told to stand down.
flaws.talks: They tell the intruder one true thing about the next room, without meaning to.
flaws.kind: They offer a Potion before the fight. They say it isn't fair otherwise.
flaws.freezes: On a bad night they don't fight at all.

delay.word: The Hero's walk through the base: {days} day{s} longer.

walk.title: Walk it
walk.intro: A borrowed party at the Hero's level. Every piece is real. Every Grunt's there, with their own kit and their own line. They don't know it's the Boss.
walk.costs: The in-person slot for the day. Nothing else. Nobody's hurt; kits are healed after.
walk.gives: Nothing on any number. It's the only way to know what it's like.
walk.noHero: There's nobody to borrow a party from yet: the Hero hasn't set out.
walk.door: The front door. It's open. It's always open to someone.
walk.office: The Office. Your own chair, from the wrong side of the desk.
walk.empty: An empty building. Footsteps. A kettle left on.
walk.nobody: Nobody stopped me. I don't know if that's because they couldn't or because they were told not to.
walk.lost: The borrowed party's done. The Hero would have stopped here, and come back tomorrow.
walk.same: Walked their own base. Then: changed nothing.
walk.opened: {name} isn't at the door. They're outside. They'd opened it.
walk.again: {name} gets up. "You'll have to go through me again."
walk.kind: {name} offers a Potion first. "It's not fair otherwise."

night.walkNone: The Boss walks the base. Nobody's in any room to speak to.

window.leaned: A light's on over the bakery. It wasn't on last night.
window.work: The bridge. You can see the lamps on it from here. Somebody's crossing.
window.quiet: It's a town. From here it's just a town.
window.hero: There's a camp-fire on the ridge. One.

rooms.barracks: Somebody's sock is still on the stove. Somebody else is reading.
rooms.mess: The stew's on for tomorrow. "Who's peeling?"
rooms.garage: The radio's still playing something nobody chose.
rooms.counting: Two books, and a lamp. "Both up to date."
rooms.infirmary: Two beds. A Chansey asleep on the spare one; nobody's the heart to move it.
rooms.listening: "Heard, and think. I'll tell you which."
rooms.workshop: A glider with one wing. "It's the other one that matters."
rooms.pen: The stalls are clean. Nobody's in them.
rooms.office: The desk. The Board on the wall.

post.step: The Post, heard: the Hero's next stop is {where}.
post.steps: The Post, heard: the Hero's next two stops are {where}.
post.scouted: The Post's had the district on the radio: every holding scouted to depth 1.
post.detective: The Post, think: Heat's {heat}. At {warn} they'll know where you are.

raid.warning: They know where you are. A detective stands in the doorway, not coming in, and says so. A day's notice.
raid.warningPost: The Listening Post: they know where you are. A day's notice.
raid.lapsed: The warning lapses. Heat's down; they'd nothing new to go on.

choices.name: Move
choices.is: A safehouse. The base is lost: its rooms, not its people
choices.gives: Heat −4. Everybody. The Wall, under Tobi's arm

choices.name: Stay, and empty it
choices.is: The Holding Pen's opened. The Vault's sent away. The law finds a building
choices.costs: The Pen's contents (they go home). A day
choices.gives: The Raid still comes. It finds beds and a kitchen

choices.name: Stay, and hold
choices.gives: A chance to keep the building

choices.name: Walk into the station
choices.gives: The courtroom's kinder to someone who came in. The Roster's not charged

wings.name: The Front
wings.is: The front door; whatever's next to it

wings.name: The Working wing
wings.is: Each room's searched as it falls

door.knock: The detective. Six constables with Growlithe and Arcanine. They knock; it's the rule.
door.open: The door's opened. The Front's Lost without a fight. Nobody's hurt. The detective says "Thank you," and means it.
door.force: It's forced. {name}, at the door, fights.
door.forceNobody: It's forced. Nobody's at the door.
door.opened: The constables were already in the yard. {name} had opened the door.

raid.slide: Constables aren't good at {piece}. It's in the log: an hour of policemen sliding into walls.

acts.aside: {name} steps aside. Puts their hands up. Answers what they're asked.
acts.doorFor: {name} holds a door so someone else can get out. Is caught. Says nothing.
acts.noBack: There's no back way. Running only goes deeper in.

raid.queue: The back way: three a turn. Those not through in time are caught.
raid.minor: (sent first: the game won't let a minor be placed lower)

office.speech: "I've been to every place you've been. A day late. I've a notebook. D'you want to know what's in it?"

clauses.waive: You waived what you were owed when it mattered.

office.never: "I don't know what to charge you with. I've never had to arrest someone who {middle}"
office.won: They withdraw. The base is held. Heat's 8, and stays there for the region.
office.lost: The detective's six win. The base is lost.
office.charge: They read the list. Aloud. Item by item. Then: "That's what I can prove. D'you want to know what I think?"
office.pen: The detective writes for a long time. "I'm still taking you in. I'm going to say you opened it before I asked. That's not a kindness. It's what happened."
office.window: The Boss goes out of the window. The base is lost; the Boss isn't caught; whoever's still inside is.
office.taken: The Boss is taken in, and out by morning: nothing on the list holds yet. The courtroom comes at the end of the run.
office.noWindow: A Small Office hasn't a window. Only a Large one.

detectives.name: DS Billie Achterberg
detectives.works: On foot. A paper bag of chestnuts.

after.title: The morning after
after.lines: The Roster's in a safehouse, or a field. Hortense is cooking on something. The Board's there, propped on a crate. The first job on it's "Find somewhere."
after.rooms: The rooms are gone. The site's gone.

visit.aside: "I told them everything. I'm sorry. No: I'm not. I'd nothing left to hold it in with."
